name: Easy Jog
short_description: Jog at a conversational pace to raise heart rate and tissue temperature.

name: Jog in Place
short_description: Jog lightly in place on the balls of the feet with relaxed arms; a quiet indoor raise.

name: Light Jumping Jacks
short_description: Perform easy-paced jumping jacks to elevate heart rate and loosen the shoulders and hips.

name: Easy Single-Unders
short_description: Jump rope at a relaxed tempo with minimal jump height to raise the heart rate and prime the ankles.

name: Jump Rope Boxer Step Warm-Up
short_description: Use a relaxed boxer step over the rope as a low-intensity, low-impact raise.

name: High-Knee March
short_description: March with exaggerated knee drive and opposite arm swing while standing tall.

name: Butt Kicks
short_description: Jog lightly while flicking the heels toward the glutes.

name: A-Skip
short_description: Skip forward driving one knee to hip height and striking down under the hips with a dorsiflexed foot.

name: Carioca
short_description: Move laterally by alternately crossing the trail leg in front of and behind the lead leg while rotating the hips.

name: Lateral Shuffle Warm-Up
short_description: Shuffle sideways in an athletic stance without crossing the feet.

name: Backpedal
short_description: Jog backward on the balls of the feet with a slight forward lean.

name: Forward Skip
short_description: Skip forward rhythmically with an easy arm swing.

name: Shadow Boxing
short_description: Throw light punches in an athletic, bouncing stance, rotating through the hips.

name: Bear Crawl Warm-Up
short_description: Crawl forward and back with knees hovering to warm the shoulders, wrists, and trunk.

name: Slow Mountain Climbers
short_description: From a high plank, drive alternate knees toward the chest at a slow, controlled tempo.

name: Step Jacks
short_description: Alternate stepping one foot out while raising the arms overhead; a quiet, no-jump raise.

name: Glute Bridge (activation)
short_description: Lie on your back and drive the hips up with a 2-second squeeze at the top.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (activation)
short_description: Bridge on one leg keeping the pelvis level, pausing at the top.

name: Clamshell
short_description: Lie on your side with knees bent and lift the top knee while keeping the feet together and pelvis still.

name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
short_description: Lying on your side, raise the straight top leg slightly behind the body and lower slowly.

name: Fire Hydrant
short_description: On hands and knees, lift one bent knee out to the side without shifting the torso.

name: Quadruped Hip Extension
short_description: On hands and knees, drive one bent knee back and up until the thigh is parallel to the floor without arching the back.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
short_description: With a mini-band around the knees or ankles, step sideways in a quarter squat keeping tension on the band.

name: Band Pull-Apart
short_description: Hold a light band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart to the chest.

name: Bird Dog (activation)
short_description: Extend the opposite arm and leg from hands and knees with a 2-second hold, keeping the hips square.

name: Dead Bug (activation)
short_description: On your back, slowly lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the low back pressed down.

name: Plank Hold (activation)
short_description: Hold a forearm or high plank with glutes squeezed and ribs down.

name: Side Plank (activation)
short_description: Hold a side plank with hips stacked and lifted.

name: Hollow Hold (activation)
short_description: Press the low back to the floor and hold the hollow shape; scale with bent knees or arms forward.

name: Superman Hold (activation)
short_description: Lying face down, lift arms, chest, and legs and hold.

name: Scap Push-Up
short_description: In a high plank with straight arms, let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away to spread them.

name: Prone Y-T-W Raises
short_description: Lying face down, raise the arms into Y, T, and W shapes with thumbs up, squeezing the shoulder blades.

name: Side-Lying Dumbbell External Rotation
short_description: Lying on your side with the elbow pinned to the ribs, rotate a very light dumbbell up from the belly.

name: Tibialis Raise
short_description: Lean your back against a wall with heels forward and lift the toes toward the shins, then lower.

name: Calf Raise (activation)
short_description: Rise slowly onto the toes and lower under control to prepare the ankles for jumping.

name: Single-Leg Balance Reach
short_description: Stand on one leg and reach the free leg or arms in several directions while keeping balance.

name: Glute Bridge March (activation)
short_description: Hold a bridge and alternately lift each foot without the hips dropping.

name: Bear Hold Shoulder Taps
short_description: In a bear hold with knees hovering, tap opposite shoulders without rocking the hips.

name: Arm Circles
short_description: Circle straight arms in small then large circles forward and backward.

name: Cross-Body Arm Swings
short_description: Swing the arms wide open and then across the chest in a hugging motion, alternating which arm is on top.

name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
short_description: Holding a wall for balance, swing one straight leg forward and back through a growing range.

name: Leg Swings (Side-to-Side)
short_description: Facing a wall, swing one leg across the body and out to the side.

name: Standing Hip Circles
short_description: Lift one knee and draw a big circle out to the side and back (gate opener), then reverse (gate closer).

name: Frankenstein Walk
short_description: Walk forward kicking a straight leg up toward the opposite outstretched hand.

name: Walking Knee Hug
short_description: Step forward, pull one knee to the chest while rising onto the toes, then step and switch.

name: Walking Quad Pull
short_description: Step forward and pull the opposite heel to the glute while reaching the free arm overhead.

name: Cat-Cow
short_description: On hands and knees, alternate rounding the spine up and letting it sag with the chest forward, moving with the breath.

name: Thread the Needle (dynamic)
short_description: From hands and knees, reach one arm under the body and then up toward the ceiling, following the hand with the eyes.

name: Open Book
short_description: Lying on your side with knees bent, rotate the top arm open across the body to the floor behind you and back.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
short_description: From a long lunge, place the inside elbow toward the instep, rotate the arm to the ceiling, then straighten the front leg.

name: Spiderman Lunge
short_description: Step a foot outside the hand into a deep lunge, sink the hips, then step to the other side.

name: Inchworm (warm-up)
short_description: Walk the hands out to a plank and walk the feet back in toward the hands, keeping the legs as straight as comfortable.

name: Down Dog to Cobra Flow
short_description: Flow from downward-facing dog to a cobra or upward dog and back, moving with the breath.

name: Hip Rotations in Push-Up Position
short_description: From a push-up position, rotate one bent knee under the body toward the opposite side and back.

name: Squat-to-Stand
short_description: Fold forward to hold the toes, drop the hips into a deep squat with chest up, then straighten the legs while holding the toes.

name: Samson Stretch
short_description: In a long lunge with arms locked overhead, drive the hips forward and reach up.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
short_description: Sit with both knees bent 90 degrees to one side and rotate the knees to the other side without using the hands if possible.

name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Rocks
short_description: In a half-kneeling or split stance, drive the front knee forward over the toes toward a wall without lifting the heel.

name: Wrist Circles and Rocks
short_description: Circle the wrists, then on hands and knees rock forward and back over the palms with fingers forward, sideways, and back.

name: Neck Half Circles
short_description: Slowly roll the chin from one shoulder down across the chest to the other shoulder.

name: Band or PVC Pass-Through
short_description: Hold a band or dowel with a wide grip and lift it overhead and behind the body with straight arms, then back.

name: Walking Lunge with Overhead Reach
short_description: Walk forward in lunges, reaching both arms overhead and slightly toward the front-leg side at the bottom.

name: Reverse Lunge with Twist
short_description: Step back into a lunge and rotate the torso toward the front leg, then return.

name: Cossack Shifts
short_description: From a wide stance, shift slowly into a deep side squat on one leg, then the other, staying low.

name: Prone Scorpion
short_description: Lying face down with arms out, lift one foot and reach it across the body toward the opposite hand.

name: Deep Squat Pry
short_description: Sit in the bottom of a squat holding a light dumbbell at the chest and use the elbows to gently pry the knees out while shifting side to side.

name: Light Dumbbell Complex
short_description: With light dumbbells, perform 5 deadlifts, 5 hang power cleans, 5 front squats, and 5 push presses without putting them down.

name: Dumbbell Snatch Progression
short_description: With a light dumbbell, perform deadlift, high pull, muscle snatch, then hang power snatch in sequence.

name: Dumbbell Clean Progression
short_description: With light dumbbells, perform hang muscle clean, hang power clean, then front squat to rehearse the rack.

name: Dip-Drive Drill
short_description: With light dumbbells at the shoulders, rehearse a vertical dip and drive to the toes, then add a press.

name: Tempo Goblet Squat
short_description: Hold a light dumbbell at the chest and lower for three seconds to full depth, then stand.

name: Light Dumbbell RDL
short_description: Perform slow Romanian deadlifts with light dumbbells to groove the hinge.

name: Hip Hinge Drill
short_description: With hands on hips or a dowel along the spine, push the hips back to a hinge keeping a neutral spine.

name: Turkish Get-Up Practice (Unloaded)
short_description: Rehearse each step of the get-up with a shoe balanced on the fist or no load.

name: Light Dumbbell Halo
short_description: Circle a light dumbbell around the head close to the neck in both directions.

name: Light Single-Arm Row
short_description: Perform easy single-arm rows with a light dumbbell, focusing on scapular movement.

name: Air Squat Build-Up
short_description: Perform air squats, gradually increasing depth and speed.

name: Push-Up Negatives
short_description: From the top of a push-up, lower for three seconds to the floor, then reset on the knees.

name: Pike Shoulder Shrug
short_description: In a pike position, shrug the shoulders toward the ears and push the floor away without bending the elbows.

name: Burpee Breakdown
short_description: Step back to plank, lower to the floor, push up, step in, and stand, gradually adding the jump.

name: Penguin Jumps
short_description: Jump with straight, tight legs and tap the thighs twice with the hands before landing.

name: Rope Handle Flicks (No Jump)
short_description: Hold both handles in one hand and spin the rope beside you from the wrist to build turning speed.

name: Single-Single-Double Drill
short_description: Perform two single-unders then one double-under on repeat, building toward consecutive double-unders.

name: High Single-Unders
short_description: Jump single-unders at double-under height with a tight body to rehearse jump timing.

name: Pogo Hops (prep)
short_description: Bounce lightly on the balls of the feet with stiff ankles and fast contacts.

name: Snap-Down
short_description: From tall on the toes with arms overhead, snap the arms down and drop into a quiet athletic quarter squat; hold 2 seconds.

name: Squat Jump to Stick
short_description: Perform a small vertical jump and land softly, freezing in a balanced quarter squat with knees tracking over toes.

name: Split-Stance Snap-Down
short_description: Snap down from tall into a split stance and stick the landing quietly.

name: Single-Leg Hop to Stick (prep)
short_description: Hop a short distance on one leg and freeze the landing for two seconds.

name: Low Line Hops
short_description: Hop lightly side to side or front to back over a line with small amplitude to prepare for jumping.

name: Build-Up Strides
short_description: Run gradually accelerating to about 80-90% speed over the distance, then walk back.

name: Split Squat Isometric Hold
short_description: Hold the bottom of a split squat with the back knee just above the floor.

name: Easy Vest Walk
short_description: Walk easily wearing the vest before vest work to let the body adapt to the load.

name: Light Farmers Hold
short_description: Hold moderate dumbbells at the sides standing tall to prime grip and bracing.
